pl.before: {third} zabija: {killer}. To zamyka się jako drugie morderstwo, z {third} jako zabójcą i {killer} jako ofiarą - świeży incydent od rzutu otwarcia, nie ciąg dalszy tego, który właśnie się skończył.
pl.after: {third} zwraca się przeciw postaci {killer}. Jeśli incydent jeszcze trwa, kończy się, a nowe morderstwo zaczyna się od rzutu otwarcia: zabójcą jest {third}, ofiarą {killer}.

removed: "not a continuation of the one that just ended" goes (X3): "a second murder" and "a new opening roll" say it.

facts.fact: The betrayal opens its own incident, so the day has two killings.
The offer lasts until the day ends.
Each incident records its own Blackened.
facts.note: Read off the close of each incident (`recordBlackened` per incident); the rule for the Class Trial is the handbook's.

en.before: Two bodies in one day, so the Class Trial has two killings to untangle. Whoever is Blackened for the first is not automatically Blackened for the second. You have until the end of the day to decide.
en.after: Two bodies in one day give the Class Trial two killings to untangle, and the Blackened of the first is not automatically the Blackened of the second. You can decide until the day ends.

pl.before: Dwa ciała jednego dnia, więc Class Trial ma do rozplątania dwa zabójstwa. Kto jest Blackened za pierwsze, nie jest automatycznie Blackened za drugie. Masz czas do końca dnia, by zdecydować.
pl.after: Zdrada otwiera osobny incydent, więc tego dnia są dwa zabójstwa, a każde ma własnego Blackened. Możesz zdecydować do końca dnia.

removed: Three sentences become two (O2).

facts.fact: During an Eclipse a betrayal costs the action's cost, is parked, and opens when the Eclipse ends.
A parked betrayal refused when the Eclipse ends gives no refund.

en.before: An Eclipse is running, so the betrayal is declared now and opens when the Eclipse ends, like any action declared in one. It costs an action, and the action stays spent even if the betrayal cannot open then.
en.after: During an Eclipse the betrayal is declared now and opens when the Eclipse ends. It costs an action, which stays spent even if the betrayal cannot open then.

pl.before: Trwa Eclipse, więc zdrada zostaje zadeklarowana teraz i rozpocznie się, gdy Eclipse się skończy - jak każda akcja zadeklarowana w jej trakcie. Kosztuje akcję, a akcja przepada, nawet jeśli zdrada nie będzie mogła się wtedy rozpocząć.
pl.after: Trwa Eclipse: wydajesz akcję teraz, a zdrada zacznie się, gdy Eclipse się skończy. Jeśli wtedy nie będzie mogła się zacząć, akcja nie wraca.

removed: "like any action declared in one" goes (O9).

facts.fact: Whispered to the GMs once the betrayal's incident opens; {killer} is the old killer, now the victim.

en.before: A second incident opens on {killer} - the betrayal.
en.after: The betrayal opens a second incident on {killer}.

pl.before: Otwiera się drugi incydent, przeciw: {killer} - zdrada.
pl.after: Zdrada otwiera drugi incydent: ofiarą jest teraz {killer}, zabójca z pierwszego.

removed: The dash aside goes (X4).

facts.fact: The reason when openMurder did not open the betrayal's incident for any other cause.
It is told to the betrayer's player (a card) or the GM (a toast).

en.after: the new incident did not start

pl.after: nie udało się otworzyć incydentu

The fight starts on turn 1 with the victim's side.
The victim's tile is "Fight Back" (DRPG.Murder.tileFightBack).

en.before: {killer} is moving on you. The incident has begun and the first turn is yours. On your character sheet, under Actions, press Fight back.
en.after: {killer} is moving on you. The incident has begun, and the first turn is yours: press Fight Back under Actions on your character sheet.

pl.before: {killer} rusza na ciebie. Incydent się zaczął i pierwsza tura jest twoja. Na karcie postaci, w zakładce Akcje, naciśnij Broń się.
pl.after: {killer} rusza na ciebie. Incydent się zaczął, a pierwsza tura jest twoja. Na arkuszu postaci, w zakładce Akcje, naciśnij „Broń się”.

The fight starts on turn 1 with the victim's side.

pl.before: Ktoś rusza na ciebie. Incydent się zaczął i pierwsza tura jest twoja. Na karcie postaci, w zakładce Akcje, naciśnij Broń się.
pl.after: Ktoś rusza na ciebie. Incydent się zaczął, a pierwsza tura jest twoja. Na arkuszu postaci, w zakładce Akcje, naciśnij „Broń się”.

en.after: The trap closes. You did not see it in time. The incident has begun, and the first turn is yours: press Fight Back under Actions on your character sheet.

pl.before: Pułapka się zamyka. Za późno, by ją zauważyć. Incydent się zaczął i pierwsza tura jest twoja - na karcie postaci, w zakładce Akcje, naciśnij Broń się.

en.after: Crisis Actions

pl.after: Akcje kryzysowe

en.after: Fight Back

pl.before: Broń się
pl.after: Broń się

facts.fact: The row's lead in the crisis menu for a free take, before " - " and the row's sentence.
On the crisis card of a free take instead of a score.

en.after: Works with no roll

pl.before: Bez rzutu - to się udaje
pl.after: Udaje się bez rzutu

en.before: Rolls: {traits} - you propose one below, the GM approves or changes it.
en.after: Rolls {traits}: you propose one below, and the GM approves or changes it.

en.before: Rolls: {traits} - Resolve is armed, so you pick one in the roll window.
en.after: Rolls {traits}: with Resolve armed, you pick one in the roll window.

pl.before: Rzut: {traits} - masz uzbrojone Resolve, więc wybierasz sam w oknie rzutu.
pl.after: Możliwe statystyki to {traits}. Masz uzbrojone Resolve, więc to ty wybierasz jedną w oknie rzutu.

removed: The colon-dash chain becomes one colon (X4, X7).

facts.fact: A critical Strike lets the killer put both points (criticalAmount 2) on one reserve of the victim's, Health or Sanity; closing the window means Health.
R1448 reads this key for any mark word beside Health or Sanity.
facts.note: A constraint on the wording, not a pin: no "mark".

en.before: The blow lands exactly where you wanted it. Both points come off the same reserve - their body, or their nerve.
en.after: The blow lands exactly where you wanted it. Choose where both points go: all to their Health or all to their Sanity. Closing the window picks Health.

pl.before: Cios trafia dokładnie tam, gdzie miał trafić. Oba punkty schodzą z tego samego zapasu - z ciała albo z nerwów.
pl.after: Krytyczny cios: oba punkty zabierasz ofierze z jednego zapasu, Health albo Sanity. Jeśli zamkniesz okno, będzie to Health.

removed: "their body, or their nerve" becomes the reserves' names, as the two buttons say (D5).

facts.fact: The GM is asked whether to end the incident when the victim runs out and two killers share the side.

en.before: {victim} has nothing left. {killers} are both in this.
en.after: {victim} is out of Health and Sanity, and {killers} are both in this.

pl.before: {victim} nie ma już nic. {killers} oboje w tym siedzą.
pl.after: {victim} nie ma już Health ani Sanity, a po stronie zabójców stoją {killers}. Zakończyć incydent?

removed: "has nothing left" names the reserves (D5).

facts.fact: Ending moves the incident to its Resolution; Cancel lets the turns go on, and the tracker can end it later.

en.before: End it now and the incident moves to the clean-up. Keep going and the turn order carries on - nobody loses a turn they were owed, and you can end it from the tracker whenever you like.
en.after: End it now and the incident moves to the clean-up. Or let the turns go on, so no one loses a turn they were owed, and end it from the tracker later.

pl.before: Zakończ teraz, a incydent przejdzie do sprzątania. Kontynuuj, a kolejność tur idzie dalej - nikt nie traci należnej tury, a zakończyć możesz ze śledzenia incydentu, kiedy zechcesz.
pl.after: Po „Zakończ incydent” zaczyna się sprzątanie. Po „Anuluj” tury idą dalej, a incydent zakończysz później w oknie śledzenia incydentu.

removed: The dash aside goes (X4).

points: Step 3 (O14, repetition): „„Zakończ incydent” przenosi incydent” repeats the noun, and the tracker should be named as in the rest of the batch (proposed: „Zakończ incydent” przenosi go do Rozstrzygnięcia. Po „Anuluj” tury idą dalej, a zakończyć możesz później w oknie śledzenia incydentu.) - executor: Taken in part: the noun is not repeated and the tracker is named as in the rest of the batch; the stage is „sprzątanie”, not „Rozstrzygnięcie”, as in the English and the batch's other cards (O14).

facts.fact: A fourth person walking into a direct incident cancels it: no death, no Blackened, no checklist.
Whispered to the GMs and the incident's audience (killer, victim, third party); the newcomer is not told.

en.before: {name} walked in on top of {third}. Four people in one room is not a murder anybody can carry out - the incident is canceled.
en.after: {name} walked in after {third}. With four people in the room, the incident is canceled.

pl.before: {name} wchodzi zaraz po postaci {third}. W pokoju są teraz cztery osoby, więc incydent zostaje odwołany.
pl.after: {name} wchodzi zaraz po postaci {third}. W pokoju są teraz cztery osoby, więc incydent zostaje odwołany.

removed: "is not a murder anybody can carry out" goes (O9); the dash aside goes (X4). "canceled" keeps the early pass's spelling.

facts.fact: Nobody dies; the damage taken and the Remnants already placed stay.

en.before: Nobody dies. What the fight already did stands: the wounds, the Sanity, and anything it left on the floor.
en.after: Nobody dies. What the fight already did stands: the Health and Sanity lost, and the Remnants it left.

pl.before: Nikt nie ginie. To, co walka już zrobiła, zostaje: rany, Sanity i cokolwiek zostawiła na podłodze.
pl.after: Nikt nie ginie, ale utracone Health i Sanity nie wracają, a postawione Remnanty zostają na miejscu.

removed: "the wounds, the Sanity" becomes the reserves lost (D5); "anything it left on the floor" is the Remnants.

facts.fact: A critical Self-Defense lets the victim's side take an action it just unlocked this turn with no roll (freeResolution, stamped with the turn).
Only the unlocked actions not taken away by the incident are opened; Role Reversal can be denied.
The free take still costs the resolution action's Sanity.
The line goes into the crisis card (`done`), whispered to the GMs and the incident's audience at the action's stage - the killer, the victim and a third party - and the actor: several readers.

en.before: You stopped them cold. Take Survive or Role Reversal this turn - no roll, it works.
en.after: This turn the victim can take Survive or Role Reversal, whichever is open, with no roll, and it works.

pl.before: Nie ruszą się z miejsca. Weź w tej turze Survive albo Role Reversal - bez rzutu, działa.
pl.after: W tej turze weź Survive albo Role reversal: działa bez rzutu. Akcja zablokowana albo odebrana w tym incydencie odpada.

removed: "You stopped them cold" and "you" go: several people read the card (P2), so the victim is named by the role.
The Sanity it still costs is left to the crisis menu, which lists it (fact 2).
disagreements: The before named both actions; when Role Reversal is denied (a Despair opening, an accomplice, a trap) only Survive opens (`applyUnlocks`). The after says "whichever is open".

points: Step 3 (EN6, glossary role-reversal): the kept N27 sentence writes „Role reversal” and the new second sentence „Role Reversal” in the same text; the glossary's form is „Role Reversal” - for the coordinator whether N27's spelling may be aligned. - executor: Kept: N27 is the owner's approved after and the check requires it word for word; the two spellings are a question for the owner (notes). The new second sentence names no action, so it adds no third spelling.

M4 (Polish): an action can be shut for the free take by more than the incident's denial - a critical Keep Your Distance blocks Role Reversal (applyHindrance, store "blocked") and crisisRefusal refuses a blocked action, free or not; the English's "whichever is open" covers it, „jeśli incydent go odebrał” does not (proposed: „W tej turze ofiara może wziąć Survive albo Role Reversal, które z nich jest dostępne, bez rzutu - i to działa.”); the same text also writes „Role reversal” and „Role Reversal” two ways (O14). - executor: Taken in part: the second sentence now covers both causes, a block (a critical Keep Your Distance) and the incident's denial; the proposed whole text is not taken, because it would replace N27, the owner's approved after, which the check requires word for word (notes); the two spellings are in the notes for the owner.

facts.fact: A GM's browser with no cast for the running incident refuses to pass a turn or let a third in.
The case's health check offers "Enter the cast by hand" (DRPG.Case.enterCast).

en.before: This browser holds no cast for the running incident, so its turn cannot be worked out here. Enter the cast by hand (the case's health check), or let the GM whose browser holds it act.
en.after: This browser lacks the incident's cast and cannot work out the turn. Press Enter the cast by hand in the health check, or let a GM who holds it act.

pl.before: Ta przeglądarka nie ma obsady trwającego incydentu, więc nie da się tu ustalić jego tury. Wpisz obsadę ręcznie (kontrola zdrowia sprawy) albo pozwól działać GM-owi, którego przeglądarka ją ma.
pl.after: Ta przeglądarka nie zna obsady trwającego incydentu, więc nie oddasz tu tury ani nie wpuścisz trzeciej osoby. Użyj „Wpisz obsadę ręcznie” w oknie „Sprawa w tej przeglądarce”.

removed: The button is named as the health check shows it.

facts.fact: Shown while the other GMs' copies of the cast have not hydrated on this browser.

en.before: The other GMs' copies of the incident's cast have not arrived on this browser yet: try again in a moment.
en.after: The other GMs' copies of the incident's cast have not reached this browser yet. Try again in a moment.

pl.before: Kopie obsady incydentu od pozostałych GM-ów jeszcze nie dotarły do tej przeglądarki: spróbuj za chwilę.
pl.after: Obsada incydentu od pozostałych GM-ów jeszcze tu nie dotarła. Spróbuj za chwilę.

removed: The colon becomes a full stop.

facts.fact: The question is asked on the killer's own browser, once a load for each mask, with Reveal yourself and Stay hidden.
A mask opens on a direct murder, not indirect and not self-inflicted, whose opening succeeds with Hope or is a critical.
While masked, the killer's tokens on every scene show the name "?", Foundry's mystery man, no ring and no name or bars; GMs and Spectators see the name drawn over the "?".
The killer is moved to a silent voice room of their own, so they neither speak to the room nor hear it, and their microphone is blocked.
The mask ends when the killer reveals themselves or at the next time of day, whichever comes first; the incident's end does not end it.
Another player's browser closes the sheet of a character whose token is masked; a GM and a Spectator see through.

en.before: Your opening went well: the victim and everyone in the room see you as "?", and your microphone is off. Reveal yourself now, or stay hidden until the time of day ends.
en.after: Your opening went well: the other players see you only as "?", and you can neither speak nor hear anyone. Reveal yourself now, or stay hidden until the time of day ends.

pl.before: Twoje otwarcie się udało: ofiara i wszyscy w pokoju widzą cię jako „?”, a twój mikrofon jest wyłączony. Ujawnij się teraz albo zostań w ukryciu do końca pory dnia.
pl.after: Otwarcie udało się z Hope albo przy krytyku, więc jesteś w ukryciu: inni gracze widzą twoje tokeny jako „?”, twój mikrofon jest wyłączony i nie słyszysz rozmów. Ukrycie trwa do następnej pory dnia, chyba że wcześniej się ujawnisz; nie przerywa go też koniec incydentu.

removed: "the victim and everyone in the room" becomes "the other players": the "?" stands on every scene for every player (fact 2).
"your microphone is off" becomes "you can neither speak nor hear anyone": the silent room also cuts what the killer hears (fact 3).
disagreements: The before said only the victim and the room see the "?" and only the microphone is off; maskPatch masks every token on every scene, and maskedRow puts the killer in a silent room where they hear nobody either. The after follows the code.

facts.fact: The card is sent when the killer is masked, after the voice and the tokens are changed.
The card is whispered to the killer's owners only, not to the GMs.
While masked, the killer's tokens on every scene show the name "?", Foundry's mystery man, no ring and no name or bars; GMs and Spectators see the name drawn over the "?".
The killer is moved to a silent voice room of their own, so they neither speak to the room nor hear it, and their microphone is blocked.
The mask ends when the killer reveals themselves or at the next time of day, whichever comes first; the incident's end does not end it.
While the mask stands, the killer's voice tile shows a Reveal yourself button.

en.before: You are hidden behind a "?" and your microphone is off, until you reveal yourself or the time of day ends. Reveal yourself is on your voice tile.
en.after: You are hidden behind a "?" and can neither speak nor hear anyone until you reveal yourself or the time of day ends. Your voice tile has a Reveal yourself button.

pl.before: Ukrywasz się za „?”, a twój mikrofon jest wyłączony, dopóki się nie ujawnisz albo nie skończy się pora dnia. Ujawnij się jest na twoim kaflu głosu.
pl.after: Jesteś w ukryciu: inni gracze widzą twoje tokeny jako „?”, twój mikrofon jest wyłączony i nie słyszysz rozmów. Ukrycie trwa do następnej pory dnia, także po końcu incydentu. Wcześniej możesz się ujawnić przyciskiem „Ujawnij się” na swoim kafelku głosu.

removed: "your microphone is off" becomes "can neither speak nor hear anyone" (fact 3).
"Reveal yourself is on your voice tile" becomes "Your voice tile has a Reveal yourself button": the same fact, read as a button.
disagreements: The before said only that the microphone is off; voice.mjs maskedRow puts the killer in a silent room of their own, so they hear nobody either.

facts.fact: The card is sent only when the mask ends at a new time of day, not on a reveal.
The card is whispered to the killer's owners only, not to the GMs.
At the end the tokens' look is put back, the microphone block lifted and the voices placed again.

en.before: You are no longer hidden: the time of day is over.
en.after: You are no longer hidden, and your voice is back: the time of day has ended.

pl.before: Nie jesteś już w ukryciu: pora dnia się skończyła.
pl.after: Zaczęła się nowa pora dnia i nie jesteś już w ukryciu: twoje tokeny wyglądają jak wcześniej, a ty znowu mówisz i słyszysz rozmowy.

facts.fact: The warning is a toast on the GM's browser that made the death public, when the student's token is on no scene with rooms (or its put-back is still on its way).
No warning for a death in the Class Trial.
No body tile is laid and nothing tries again; the loot is then read at the student's token.

en.before: The GMs cannot place {name}'s token on a scene with rooms (there is none, or a put-back of it is still on its way), so no body was left on the map; what they carried is searched beside their token.
en.after: {name}'s token is on no scene with rooms, so no body was left on the map. Their belongings can be searched at their token instead.

pl.before: GM-owie nie mogą umieścić tokenu postaci {name} na scenie z pokojami (nie ma go albo jego cofnięcie jest jeszcze w drodze), więc na mapie nie zostało ciało; to, co miała przy sobie, przeszukuje się obok jej tokenu.
pl.after: Token postaci {name} nie stoi na żadnej scenie z pokojami, więc na mapie nie będzie ciała. Rzeczy tej postaci przeszukuje się przy jej tokenie.

removed: "there is none, or a put-back of it is still on its way": the reason the code has for the missing token is cut (T29); the fact stays in the facts.
"The GMs cannot place" becomes the plain fact that the token is on no scene with rooms.

points: Step 3 (O17, calque): „jego cofnięcie jest jeszcze w drodze” mirrors „its put-back is still on its way”; nobody at a Polish table says it (proposed: Token postaci {name} nie stoi na żadnej scenie z pokojami albo jeszcze na nią nie wrócił, więc na mapie nie będzie ciała. Rzeczy tej postaci przeszukuje się przy jej tokenie.) - executor: Taken in part: the calque is gone; „albo jeszcze na nią nie wrócił” is left out, because the English cuts the token's put-back as the code's reason (T29) and both languages carry the same facts.

facts.fact: A Mastermind whose own token stands in their room sees every character's token on the map, as a GM does, and loses it on leaving.
The Mastermind's player can lock or open the room from their sheet, with the GM's room lock.
The sheet's lock line is drawn only on the Mastermind's player's browser.
tokenShownTo answers the Eclipse before the lair, so during an Eclipse the Mastermind in their room sees no other token.

en.before: The room with the cameras: from here the Mastermind sees the whole map.
en.after: While the Mastermind stands in this room, they see every character's token on the map, as the GMs do, except during an Eclipse. From their sheet they can lock or open its door.

pl.before: Pokój z kamerami: stąd Mastermind widzi całą mapę.
pl.after: Gdy token Masterminda stoi w tym pokoju, Mastermind widzi na mapie tokeny wszystkich postaci, jak GM, poza Eclipse; po wyjściu traci ten widok. Gracz Masterminda może zamknąć i otworzyć ten pokój ze swojego arkusza postaci.

removed: "The room with the cameras" is the fiction's name for what the next sentence states; cut (T29).
disagreements: The before said the Mastermind sees the whole map from here; settings.mjs and visibility.mjs give them the cast's tokens while their own token stands in the room, and the GM handbook says the same. The after follows the code (an early-pass key, rewritten in full).

facts.fact: The Mastermind window picks who is the Mastermind among the students, GM only.
The pick reaches the chosen student's player privately as a yes, with their room.

en.before: Pick before the season, with the player's agreement.
en.after: Pick them before the season starts, with that player's agreement.

pl.before: Wybierz przed sezonem, za zgodą gracza.
pl.after: Wybierz, który uczeń jest Mastermindem.

en.after: The Mastermind has {held} Hope.

pl.before: Hope teraz: {held}.
pl.after: Mastermind ma teraz {held} Hope.

facts.fact: Starting refuses with no Mastermind set, then asks; on yes it sets the Final Trial and announces it to the whole table with a banner and a line.
The switch to start is offered on the Class Trial console only while no trial runs.

en.after: Start the Final Trial? Everyone at the table sees it announced.

pl.after: Zacząć Final Trial? Ogłoszenie zobaczy cały stół.

en.after: The Mastermind died earlier this season, so whoever was accused, the truth is revealed and nobody new is executed.

facts.fact: Named and alive: the Mastermind is sentenced and executed when the trial ends, or at once if the verdict comes after End the trial.
The public card says THE MASTERMIND IS DEFEATED and The killing game is over; otherwise THE TRUTH IS REVEALED and The game they were playing was never what it seemed.
Wrong, or the Mastermind already dead: nobody new dies.
Either way the Final Trial ends and the Mastermind pick is cleared.

en.before: Correct: the Mastermind is executed when the trial ends and the killing game is over. Wrong, or already dead: nobody new is executed - the table is shown that the game was never what it looked like.
en.after: If the vote named the Mastermind, they are executed when the trial ends, or at once if it already has, and the killing game is over. Otherwise, or if the Mastermind is already dead, nobody new is executed and the table learns the game was never what it seemed. Either way, the Final Trial ends and the pick is cleared.

pl.before: Trafnie: Mastermind zostaje stracony, gdy rozprawa się skończy, a killing game dobiega końca. Błędnie albo Mastermind już nie żyje: nikt nowy nie ginie - stół widzi, że gra nigdy nie była tym, na co wyglądała.
pl.after: Trafnie, a Mastermind żyje: zostaje skazany i ginie, gdy rozprawa się skończy (od razu, jeśli już się skończyła), a stół widzi, że killing game dobiegła końca. Błędnie albo Mastermind już nie żyje: nikt nowy nie ginie, a stół widzi, że prawda wyszła na jaw. Tak czy inaczej Final Trial się kończy, a wybór Masterminda znika.
